news.title: Your institution’s website should prioritize prospective students
news.summary_en: I’ve spent more than 30 years working in higher education, so I know my way around a college website. I understand how institutions are organized. I know the difference between admissions and enrollment, academic affairs and student affairs, advancement and communications. I generally have a pretty good idea of where information should live.

news.title: When AI’s architects ask to slow down, education must speak up
news.summary_en: When the people building the world’s most powerful artificial intelligence systems warn that their creations are advancing too quickly, the rest of society should stop and listen.
